{{Top|leg}}
'''Radell Central''' was an Imperial-class [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. It was established solely to accommodate [[Radell Mining Corporation]]'s ore carriers.
